scope: Read-only original PermWorld unit audit; table recomputation, byte hashes and saved completion records. No model forward, optimizer, training, new anchors or Git modifications.

world_sampling.split_rule: Sequential unbiased acceptance of seeded random permutations, reject non-eight-element orbits/history/within-world overlap; no answer-based balancing or selection.
world_sampling.independence: Independent data/model/batch/dropout seeds per unit, conditional on the fixed mathematical universe and historical exclusions. Do not force global cross-world disjointness; accidental overlaps do not enter cross-world model comparisons.

training_seed_policy.old_tasks_formula: 95400000 + 1000 * architecture_index + old_task_index; indexes transformer=0/gru=1 and tasks in the listed order
training_seed_policy.old_tasks_encoding_pairing: Identical saved start RNG within architecture and task across encodings
training_seed_policy.added_12_tasks: Reuse the exact saved architecture-specific descents starting RNG. All 12 added tasks plus descents share it; no distinct per-added-task seeds.
training_seed_policy.new_unit_requirement: Resample data, batch, architecture initial and dropout seed bases independently between units while preserving this within-unit coupling pattern.

evaluation_randomness.reason: No random evaluation sampler; original generator consumes one data_rng sequentially for train, validation and test. Evaluation is deterministic with dropout disabled. Evaluation inputs are resampled by each unit data_seed.
evaluation_randomness.length_weights: 1/21 fixed; any undefined length preserves undefined aggregate, no reweighting

comparison_B_zero.scope: Shared numerical parameters within architecture, task-before readout (input end), model.eval(), common raw anchors and common preprocessing. Candidate task is not in the measured prefix. Candidate-specific answer residualization and selected support need not share a zero.
comparison_B_zero.not_claimed: Training contrast does not isolate pure mathematical relation, and within-unit sharing cannot identify cross-initialization robustness.

counts_recomputed_from.A: Original per_length_results.csv, exact final_norm/hidden/linear_cka then fixed 21-length averaging
counts_recomputed_from.B: Original pair_summary.csv, all 15 right candidates, designate versus other14; rank strictly greater and exact ties
counts_recomputed_from.rank_rule: Unique first iff no other score > designated and no exact tie. No significance/binomial model.

audit_limits: Weights are bound to the saved real initial state by checkpoint/completion metadata and historical execution audit. This no-forward audit verifies bytes and completion bindings; it does not rerun historical training.
Original independent unit is exploratory; four new units are independent repetitions conditional on the fixed universe, not retroactive prospective registration of the first unit.
Models and 32 conditions within a unit share anchors/weights/random streams; they are not independent inferential units.

historical_process_wall_cost.limit: Recorded process wall across historical hardware/scheduling; not active GPU time or a runtime guarantee for current resources. Original16models were historically slower than48extension.

protected_results_this_audit: No repository files were written by this read-only audit; only the explicitly requested external audit directory was written.
